entities.summary: Henry Arthur Kamen is a British historian who has published extensively on Spain and the Spanish Empire. In particular he has contributed to studies of the Spanish Inquisition: his The Spanish Inquisition, originally published in 1965, was revised and expanded in The Spanish Inquisition: A Historical Revision, published in 1998. In 2017, Kamen was indicted for possessing child pornography in Athens, Georgia.
